crosswalks.resolution_method: Complete France-region selector checked against the same continental departmental envelope used for the source estimate; calibrated area differs by about 1.3%.
crosswalks.notes: The population and boundary refer to continental geographical France, not merely the narrower 1328 royal fiscal domain.

area_comparison.historical_area_source: Statistics Iceland / National Land Survey, Iceland in Figures

crosswalks.resolution_method: All twenty-one Iceland-area locations are selected; no Iceland location is omitted or mixed with another country.
required_actions: repair the accepted Jacobian/polygon area calibration before final physical-model fitting
do not reinterpret the area error as partial historical-boundary coverage
crosswalks.notes: Boundary membership is exact, but the numerical area feature is materially low and remains a separate physical-input blocker.

area_comparison.historical_area_source: Statistics Faroe Islands, Islands, mountains, islets and lakes

crosswalks.resolution_method: The EU5 torshavn location is the complete archipelago footprint; calibrated area is within 1.4% of the official 1,396 km2.
crosswalks.notes: The former zero-location crosswalk was caused by searching for 'Faroe' rather than the actual EU5 tag torshavn.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Main island of Sicily, excluding Malta
crosswalks.resolution_method: All twenty-two main-island locations in sicily_area are selected and the malta location is explicitly removed; the calibrated footprint is within 4.1% of the island area.
crosswalks.notes: The source population is island Sicily, so Malta must not share the aggregate label despite being placed in EU5's sicily_area.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Mamluk Egypt proper: Nile Delta, Nile Valley, western oases and Red Sea dependencies, excluding Sinai and Cyrenaica

area_comparison.area_interpretation: The source is a national agrarian aggregate; mapped area includes desert inside Egyptian administrative footprints, while the mechanistic model separately constrains productive land.

crosswalks.resolution_method: All lower- and upper-Egypt locations are selected; Sinai and Cyrenaica are separate EU5 areas and are excluded by construction.
crosswalks.notes: This maps the national aggregate without pretending the Fayyum tax register supplies an independent population total.
